title: EU AI Act: High-risk compliance in practice

modules.title: Define the system and its compliance boundary
Make and maintain the deployment decision

concepts.name: Ai system boundary
concepts.assessment: Distinguish an inference-based AI system from a fixed rule or stored output.

concepts.name: Intended purpose
concepts.assessment: Identify the purpose established by a system's supplied information and intended use.

concepts.name: Eu connection
concepts.assessment: Identify an EU placement, deployment or output-use connection.

concepts.name: System provider
concepts.assessment: Identify a person developing or commissioning and supplying/servicing under their name.

concepts.name: System deployer
concepts.assessment: Identify professional use under an actor's authority.

concepts.name: Other operators
concepts.assessment: Distinguish representative, importer and distributor from provider/deployer.

concepts.name: High risk route
concepts.assessment: Apply a supplied Annex I or Annex III route and the relevant exceptions.

concepts.name: Limited sector applicability
concepts.assessment: Identify Section B's limited route and avoid an unsupported Section A duplication waiver.

concepts.name: Classification record
concepts.assessment: Record classification evidence or a justified Article 6(3) assessment.

concepts.name: Duty application date
concepts.assessment: Match a duty to its own application date.

concepts.name: Legacy design transition
concepts.assessment: Distinguish an existing-system transition from unlimited grandfathering.

concepts.name: Parallel obligations
concepts.assessment: Identify remaining prohibition, transparency or data-law checks after classification.

concepts.name: Lifecycle risk management
concepts.assessment: Recognise the continuing risk-management cycle.

concepts.name: Foreseeable misuse
concepts.assessment: Distinguish intended use from reasonably foreseeable misuse.

concepts.name: Residual risk
concepts.assessment: Identify risk remaining after controls and the need to assess acceptability.

concepts.name: Scope record case
concepts.assessment: Produce a conditional actor/classification/date record.

concepts.name: Risk control hierarchy
concepts.assessment: Choose feasible design reduction, then appropriate controls and information.

concepts.name: Prior test criteria
concepts.assessment: Define purpose-appropriate metrics and thresholds before testing.

concepts.name: Vulnerable person risk
concepts.assessment: Identify intended-purpose risks to children and other vulnerable groups.

concepts.name: Dataset roles
concepts.assessment: Distinguish training, validation and testing sets and the non-training route.

concepts.name: Dataset provenance
concepts.assessment: Identify origins, collection processes and original personal-data purpose.

concepts.name: Data preparation
concepts.assessment: Identify relevant preparation operations and measurement assumptions.

concepts.name: Dataset representativeness
concepts.assessment: Assess relevance, representation, errors and completeness for intended use.

concepts.name: Deployment context fit
concepts.assessment: Identify geographic, contextual, behavioural or functional mismatch.

concepts.name: Data gap remediation
concepts.assessment: Identify a material data gap and a proposed response.

concepts.name: Bias feedback loop
concepts.assessment: Recognise harmful or discriminatory bias, including outputs reused as inputs.

concepts.name: Bias mitigation
concepts.assessment: Select detection, prevention and mitigation measures for identified bias.

concepts.name: Sensitive bias necessity
concepts.assessment: Test strict necessity and ineffective less intrusive alternatives.

concepts.name: Sensitive bias safeguards
concepts.assessment: Apply the full Article 4a(1) safeguard set to a proposed workflow.

concepts.name: Extended bias permission
concepts.assessment: Distinguish Article 4a(2)'s wider actors/risks and absence of a new bias-check duty.

concepts.name: Data file case
concepts.assessment: Decide whether a proposed data/bias workflow has sufficient evidence.

concepts.name: Technical file
concepts.assessment: Identify a pre-release, maintained technical compliance file.

concepts.name: Technical evidence index
concepts.assessment: Map an Annex IV element to clear, versioned evidence.

concepts.name: Integrated product file
concepts.assessment: Identify the single documentation set required for a covered Section A product.

concepts.name: Logging capability
concepts.assessment: Specify events enabling risk/modification traceability and operational monitoring.

concepts.name: Controlled log retention
concepts.assessment: Apply appropriate controlled-log retention without conflating it with document retention.

concepts.name: Deployer instructions
concepts.assessment: Identify required, accessible instructions on capabilities, limitations and operation.

concepts.name: Output interpretation
concepts.assessment: Identify information enabling a deployer to interpret and use an output appropriately.

concepts.name: Effective oversight controls
concepts.assessment: Specify proportionate monitoring, override and safe intervention capabilities.

concepts.name: Automation bias
concepts.assessment: Recognise over-reliance on an output despite a nominal human reviewer.

concepts.name: Purpose performance metrics
concepts.assessment: Select suitable accuracy evidence and declare the relevant metrics.

concepts.name: Fault resilience
concepts.assessment: Select lifecycle resilience and, where appropriate, fail-safe or redundancy measures.

concepts.name: Ai cybersecurity
concepts.assessment: Select proportionate defences against model, data, input or confidentiality attacks.

concepts.name: Technical readiness case
concepts.assessment: Identify missing evidence in a technical readiness review.

concepts.name: Provider duty map
concepts.assessment: Allocate Article 16 responsibilities, including release-gate handoffs.

concepts.name: Provider identity
concepts.assessment: Identify required provider identity/contact information.

concepts.name: Provider accessibility
concepts.assessment: Identify Article 16(l)'s accessibility-law requirement without inventing a universal certificate.

concepts.name: Quality management system
concepts.assessment: Identify the written processes and accountability required by Article 17.

concepts.name: Proportionate quality implementation
concepts.assessment: Distinguish organisational proportionality from reduced protection.

concepts.name: Sector governance integration
concepts.assessment: Identify sector integration and the qualified financial-institution treatment.

concepts.name: Documentation custody
concepts.assessment: Identify which provider records must remain available for ten years.

concepts.name: Authority cooperation
concepts.assessment: Identify information, controlled-log access and language requirements for a reasoned request.

concepts.name: Documentation continuity
concepts.assessment: Identify the need to check Member State conditions after bankruptcy or cessation.

concepts.name: Provider corrective action
concepts.assessment: Choose appropriate immediate correction, withdrawal, disabling or recall.

concepts.name: Provider risk information
concepts.assessment: Identify investigation and communication obligations when a system presents a risk.

concepts.name: Representative mandate
concepts.assessment: Identify the third-country provider's EU mandate, tasks and termination trigger.

concepts.name: Importer verification
concepts.assessment: Identify verification, withholding, custody and cooperation duties before/after import.

concepts.name: Distributor verification
concepts.assessment: Identify distribution checks, withholding, correction and cooperation duties.

concepts.name: Changed provider role
concepts.assessment: Apply rebranding, substantial modification or high-risk purpose-change rules.

concepts.name: Supplier access agreement
concepts.assessment: Specify required supplier information/access and the limited open-source exception.

concepts.name: Value chain case
concepts.assessment: Allocate responsibilities after a supplied change/supplier scenario.

concepts.name: Deployer instructions use
concepts.assessment: Specify technical and organisational measures for use according to instructions.

concepts.name: Oversight assignment
concepts.assessment: Assign a person with competence, training, authority and support.

concepts.name: Controlled input quality
concepts.assessment: Apply relevance/representation duties to inputs the deployer controls.

concepts.name: Deployer monitoring escalation
concepts.assessment: Identify monitoring, risk suspension and serious-incident communication duties.

concepts.name: Deployer log custody
concepts.assessment: Identify custody and retention for automatically generated logs under deployer control.

concepts.name: Workplace information
concepts.assessment: Identify affected-worker/representative information before workplace deployment.

concepts.name: Public deployer registration
concepts.assessment: Identify public deployer registration checks and the no-use consequence of missing registration.

concepts.name: Affected person information
concepts.assessment: Identify notice when Annex III high-risk AI makes or assists person-related decisions.

concepts.name: Fria trigger
concepts.assessment: Apply Article 27's actor/use triggers and point 2 exclusion.

concepts.name: Fria content update
concepts.assessment: Specify assessment elements, first-use/update treatment and authority notification.

concepts.name: Fria dpia reuse
concepts.assessment: Reuse relevant DPIA material while addressing remaining fundamental-rights duties.

concepts.name: Post remote biometric route
concepts.assessment: Identify targeted-use authorisation, refusal consequences and reporting boundaries.

concepts.name: Biometric dual verification
concepts.assessment: Identify the two-person verification rule and its qualified sector exceptions.

concepts.name: Biometric log fields
concepts.assessment: Specify the minimum remote-identification fields and distinguish operational records.

concepts.name: Dossier evidence gaps
concepts.assessment: Identify unresolved technical and actor evidence in the dossier.

concepts.name: Deployment gate review
concepts.assessment: Identify date, operation, information and impact-assessment gates.

concepts.name: Compliance decision case
concepts.assessment: Issue a conditional decision with owners, remaining gates and reassessment triggers.
